_about: Manuscripts dated in the Aṃśuvarman ('Mānadeva') saṃvat that are in the NGMCP title list (data/ngmcpdb_production.sql.bz2, calendar 'MS') but have no descriptive catalogue entry. (C 80/7, the Suśrutasaṃhitā of saṃvat 301, was listed here until its entry was found in the wiki mirror; see parse_mirror.py.) Date elements beyond era and year are cited from the literature. D 41/7 (Aṣṭasāhasrikā, Newari script, title list 'MS 901') is left out: 901 is impossible in this era and is most likely an NS year (c. 1781).
